name: saketjs
description: A lightweight vanilla JS library for mouse followers, magnetic buttons, image hover effects, text animations (incl. 3D reveal), smooth scroll, parallax, marquees, ripples, a flexible string divider, particle network backgrounds, SVG/counter loaders, clip-path title reveals, image sequences, and multi-style page transitions (incl. scribble + Barba-style AJAX mode) — inspired by Shery.js, zero extra imports needed.
